title: StandGuard Bench Configuration
description: A hardware-in-the-loop test bench described as data: channels, pins, rails, interlocks, and sequences. Linted by the StandGuard check catalog.

campaign_window_s.description: Total time budget for the campaign. Checked by timing.budget.

channels.description: Every signal on the bench. Checked by schema.channels, unique.name, pin.conflict, limits.*, interlock.*, timing.*.

pin.description: Physical pin or resource identifier, e.g. "P1.3", "SPI0". Must be unique across channels (pin.conflict).

kind.description: power and analog_out are drive channels; analog_in and digital input-only channels are measurement lines.

voltage_v.description: Nominal drive voltage. Must not exceed max_voltage_v (limits.voltage).

interlock.description: Name of the interlock loop that cuts this channel. Required for channels rated >= 24 V (interlock.missing); must resolve (interlock.undefined).

max_signal_freq_hz.description: Fastest signal component of interest. sample_rate_hz must be >= 2x this (timing.nyquist).

type.description: hardware_estop is a physical e-stop loop; relay_loop a switched cut; software is advisory-only protection.

cuts.description: Channel names this loop de-energizes. Every entry must be a defined channel (interlock.cuts).

channel.description: Target channel. Must be defined (sequence.reference). Not required for "wait".

amplitude_v.description: Drive amplitude for stimulate steps. Must stay under the channel's max_voltage_v (stimulus.overdrive).
